label: PF Backlog 58
title: Backend: self-service purchase -> license issue -> tenant provisioning (and operator-manual path)
body: Two onboarding paths: (a) SELF-SERVICE - customer buys online, a license key is issued, and a tenant + owner user are provisioned automatically; (b) OPERATOR-MANUAL - an operator adds the tenant + license in the platform admin and the customer is enabled. Needs a checkout/billing integration (provider TBD later), license issuance, and idempotent tenant provisioning. Pricing deferred; structure now.

dashboard_impact.reason: licensing surface exists in the operator/customer console
